content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: RITES Limited has announced a total of 12 vacancies for various engineering and architecture professional positions. The post-wise vacancy details are given below.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
RITES Engineering Professionals Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification, experience and age conditions mentioned for the respective post. Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. Master's Degree in Structural Engineering. Minimum 11 years of post-qualification experience. Minimum 5 years experience in design of multi-storied buildings including RCC, Steel and Composite Structures. Desirable: Knowledge of structural design software such as ETABS, STAAD, SAFE etc. The educational qualification and experience requirements vary according to the Assistant Manager post.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates selected under RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 will receive salary as per the regular pay scale of RITES Limited. The pay scale varies according to the post. Apart from basic pay, selected candidates will be eligible for applicable benefits as per RITES rules, including allowances and other company benefits.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 are required to pay the application fee through the prescribed online payment mode. The fee payment must be completed through the online application portal. Applications submitted without the required fee (where applicable) will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 differs according to the post applied for. Document Scrutiny Verification of Original Documents Interview The interview carries 100% weightage consisting of technical and professional proficiency along with personality, communication and competency assessment. Written Test Document Scrutiny Interview Candidates qualifying in the written test will be called for document scrutiny and interview as per the selection procedure.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineering Professionals Exam Centres 2026
content_sections.text: The written test may be conducted at different locations. Candidates can provide their preferred examination centre during the online application process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 through the official RITES website before the last date. Visit the official RITES website. Open the recruitment section and select the Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 notification. Complete the online registration process. Fill in personal details, educational qualifications and professional experience. Upload the required documents, photograph and signature. Pay the application fee according to your category. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by RITES Limited for appointing engineering and architecture professionals on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are available for DGM and Assistant Manager level posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The required qualification varies by post. Candidates must have relevant engineering or architecture degrees along with required professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RITES Engineering Professionals Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 41 years for DGM and 32 years for Assistant Manager posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The pay scale is ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000 for DGM and ₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000 for Assistant Manager posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes document scrutiny, written test (for Assistant Manager posts) and interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for RITES Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official RITES website before 30 September 2026.
